scheme_name: Monthly Grant To Old Crafts Persons (Pension)
other_conditions: Must be a native or resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years
Must have practiced the craft for at least 5 years in the Union Territory of Puducherry
Should not be a recipient of similar financial assistance from any other source
benefits_summary: Eligible artisans receive a monthly grant of ₹2,000, continued for their lifetime subject to annual renewal.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
